'''Cratala''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] expert in [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] design and research during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] personal medical staff saw her as a genius, so he had them try to force her onto his staff. Due to this, and other corruption in the Republic, she defected to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], and took her assistants with her. The Separatists stationed her and her staff on a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Salvara system/Legends|Salvara system]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], where they worked on [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] and [[Droid/Legends|droid]] technology for the war effort. When the Clone wars came to a close, she was rescued from incoming [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces by her friend, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rel Harsol]] and the [[Sa Nalaor/Legends|''Sa Nalaor'']], until they crashed on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Cholganna/Legends|Cholganna]]. She was among the survivors of the crash, and spent her time on Cholganna continuing her research.
